snippet.title: Freddi Fish and Luther's Maze Madness Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
Freddi Fish and Luther's Maze Madness Full Playthrough

Freddi Fish and Luther's Maze Madness is a game created by Humongous Entertainment in 1996. In this game, you must help Freddi Fish collect all of Grandma Grouper's kelp seeds in 50 maze levels filled with obstacles, enemies, powerups, and bonus items. It also features a customized level editor, but it's very limited since the editor only lets you use about 10% of what's in the original maze.

Buy the game on Steam here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/284020/
